Meanwhile p3 is clearly dominant with $1968 and a near-complete pink monopoly, so my path to winning is narrow—browns might be my best shot, especially with only 14 houses left in the bank. Given p4's desperation at just $13 cash, I'll counter their mortgaged offer at $120 instead of $115, betting they're too cash-strapped to walk away.
